summary: Platforms like EOS and IOS have privilege modes required by some modules; with network_cli, set become yes and become_method enable to enter privileged mode for tasks.
questions: How do I enter privileged mode on Arista EOS with Ansible?
Why does my user-management task fail on a Cisco switch?

answer_card.title: Privilege escalation on EOS and IOS
answer_card.answer_md:
Modules that change system state (users, for example) need high privilege. With `network_cli`:
```ini
[eos:vars]
ansible_connection=ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os=arista.eos.eos
ansible_become=yes
ansible_become_method=enable
```
